<h2 class="nv-section-title"><a href="/docs/rules/routing/declaring-a-route/">Declaring a route</a><span class="nv-section-count">12</span></h2>

<section class="nv-section">
<h2 class="nv-section-title"><a href="/docs/rules/routing/matching/">Matching, not dispatching</a><span class="nv-section-count">6</span></h2>
<p class="nv-section-blurb">The router stops at a name and typed parameters. It carries nothing invocable, and the server dispatches none of it.</p>
<ol class="nv-rule-list"><li><a href="/docs/rules/routing/matching/#matching-is-not-dispatching">The router stops at matching: a match is a name and typed parameters, and nothing here href="/docs/rules/routing/matching/#a-match-is-not-invocable">A match carries a name and typed parameters and nothing invocable, and typed <code>callable</code> would not change that</a><span
